text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 38::Three years.
]


On a promissory note given by the maker to a third person to be delivered to the payee after a certain event should happen.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the delivery to the payee.
